info.title: MyArchitectAI API
info.description:
AI rendering API for architecture and interior design. Create photorealistic renderings, transfer styles between images, edit images with natural language, upscale images up to 8K, turn static renders into animations, and more. Rendering images in 13s, editing images in 1-3s, animating renders in 60-90s. Best practices [here](https://www.myarchitectai.com/rendering-tutorials).

## Rate limits

Each API key is limited to **5 requests per second** with a burst allowance of **20 requests**. Requests over the limit are rejected with HTTP `429` and the body `{"error":"Too Many Requests"}`. Rejected requests are never charged.

Build a fallback into your integration: on a `429`, retry with exponential backoff and jitter (e.g. wait 1s, then 2s, 4s, up to a few attempts) instead of failing or retrying immediately.

## Error handling

**Check the response body, not just the status code.** Generation endpoints run behind a streamed response so the connection stays open for long jobs, which means the HTTP status is committed before the job finishes. A job that fails *during* generation therefore still returns `200`, with an error body instead of a result.

Treat a `200` as successful only if the body contains an `output` key. If it contains an `error` key the request failed and the charge was refunded — `cost` is `0` and `balance` reflects the refund. Always include `requestId` when contacting support.

Failures that happen *before* generation starts (authentication, insufficient funds, rate limits) are returned with their real status codes and never reach the streamed path.

## Request size

Request bodies are capped at **10 MB**. Oversized requests are rejected with HTTP `413` and a **plain-text** body (`HTTP content length exceeded 10485760 bytes.`) — this one is not JSON and carries neither `error` nor `message`, because it is rejected before the JSON error shape is applied. Base64-encoding inflates an image by roughly 33%, so prefer passing a URL over inline base64 for large sources.

post.description: Generate a photorealistic interior render from a 3D view export from any CAD or 3D modeling tool. Optionally guide the output with a text prompt.

200.description: Request completed — **inspect the body to determine success**. Contains `output` if the generation succeeded, or `error` if the job failed after the response stream opened (see *Error handling* above). A failed job is refunded: `cost` is `0` and `balance` reflects the refund.

post.description: Analyze the input image and generate a detailed, comma-separated prompt describing its every aspect. Returns the generated prompt as text in output (not a URL). We highly recommend using it for pre-filling the prompt field of the render endpoints.

post.description: Edit an existing image with a natural-language instruction. The model applies the requested change while matching the input's aspect ratio. Returns the edited image URL.

post.description: Change the surface textures and materials of the masked area of an image while keeping its geometry and layout. Requires a `mask` marking the surfaces to retexture (white = change, black = keep; URL or base64). Choose exactly one of two modes: pass a `referenceImage` of the desired texture, or describe the texture with a `prompt` — providing both is rejected. Returns the resulting image URL as the only element of the output array.

200.description: Request completed — **inspect the body to determine success**. Contains `output` if the generation succeeded, or `error` if the job failed after the response stream opened (see *Error handling* above). A failed job is refunded: `cost` is `0` and `balance` reflects the refund.

post.description: Change the atmosphere of an image — relight an interior or change the time of day, season, or weather of an exterior — while keeping its geometry and materials. Set `sceneType` to choose the mode: `interior` requires a `lighting` value; `exterior` requires at least one of `timeOfDay`, `season`, or `weather` (any combination). Fields from the other mode are rejected. Returns the resulting image URL as the first element of the output array.

200.description: Request completed — **inspect the body to determine success**. Contains `output` if the generation succeeded, or `error` if the job failed after the response stream opened (see *Error handling* above). A failed job is refunded: `cost` is `0` and `balance` reflects the refund.

post.description: Upscale an image while preserving details and sharpness. Outputs 3840 (4K, default) or 7680 (8K) pixels on the longer side, controlled by the `targetResolution` parameter. Note: `outputFormat: png` is not available at `8k` (the output file would exceed storage size limits) — use `webp` or `jpg` for 8K, or `png` at `4k`.

negativePrompt.description: Text describing elements to exclude from the output

styleTransferStrength.description: How strongly to apply the reference style (0 = no effect, 1 = full transfer)

image.description: Source image to edit. Either a public HTTPS URL reachable by MyArchitectAI, or an inline `data:image/<mime>;base64,<payload>` URI for local files.

prompt.description: Natural-language instruction describing the edit to apply

referenceImage.description: Optional reference image (e.g. a product photo or material sample) sent to the model together with the source image. Either a public HTTPS URL reachable by MyArchitectAI, or an inline `data:image/<mime>;base64,<payload>` URI for local files. Refer to the reference image as "attached image" and be specific about how to apply it. For example: "apply the attached material on the backsplash" or "replace the pendant light with the one from the attached image".

season.description: Season to render. Exterior mode only; at least one of timeOfDay, season, or weather is required.

weather.description: Weather to render. Exterior mode only; at least one of timeOfDay, season, or weather is required.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the motion to animate

endFrameUrl.description: Optional image to use as the end frame. When provided, the video interpolates from the start frame to this frame. Either a public HTTPS URL reachable by MyArchitectAI, or an inline `data:image/<mime>;base64,<payload>` URI for local files.

image.description: Source image to analyze. Either a public HTTPS URL reachable by MyArchitectAI, or an inline `data:image/<mime>;base64,<payload>` URI for local files.

output.description: The generated comma-separated render prompt (plain text, not a URL)

balance.description: Remaining account balance after this request

requestId.description: Unique ID of this request — include it when contacting support or cross-referencing the request log

error.description: Error message describing what went wrong

message.description: Deprecated duplicate of `error`, emitted only on gateway-level failures (403, 429, 5xx) for backwards compatibility. Read `error` instead.

Unauthorized.description: API key not recognised by the billing service

PaymentRequired.description: Insufficient funds — top up the account balance before retrying. The request is not charged.

RequestTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the 10 MB limit. Note this response is **plain text, not JSON** (`content-type: text`) with the body `HTTP content length exceeded 10485760 bytes.` — it is rejected at the gateway front door before any JSON error shape is applied, so it carries neither `error` nor `message`. Base64-encoding inflates an image by ~33%; pass a URL instead of inline base64 for large sources.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded — more than 5 requests/second (burst 20) from this API key. Retry with exponential backoff; rejected requests are not charged.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Billing service temporarily unreachable. The request is not charged; retry with backoff.
